story.titleZh: 阿尔本称2026新规削弱其最大优势
story.summaryZh: 续约威廉姆斯的阿尔本认为，2026年F1新规削弱了他的关键优势，这或许可以部分解释他本赛季的挣扎表现。
story.originalTitle: F1 2026 has neutered Albon's biggest strengths
story.summaryEn: Alex Albon, who has recommitted to Williams, believes the 2026 F1 regulations have neutered his key strengths, which might partly explain his difficult season.
detailZh: 重新与威廉姆斯一级方程式车队续约的亚历克斯·阿尔本认为，2026年的规则削弱了他的核心优势，这或许可以部分解释他这个赛季的艰难处境。
威廉姆斯本赛季的表现远低于人们的殷切期望，这意味着阿尔本和他的队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯几乎没有机会为积分而战。
但阿尔本的挣扎尤为明显，他在排位赛中被塞恩斯以12比1全面压制，平均差距接近0.3秒。正赛中的差距要小一些，阿尔本也为威廉姆斯拿到了车队11个积分中的5个，但毫无疑问，塞恩斯是本赛季威廉姆斯阵营中更强的车手，而去年两人合作的首个赛季中，他还与阿尔本实力相当。
不过，要弄清其中的确切原因并不容易，因为威廉姆斯车队遇到了无数可靠性问题以及性能稳定性问题，加上赛车速度也不如预期。
再加上2026年的新规以及动力单元的一些特殊问题，让人很难有把握地判断哪些车手表现最好，尤其是像梅赛德斯上个月在斯帕赛后透露的那种能量部署问题，它一直在影响拉塞尔。
“说实话，真的很难说清楚，”当The 比赛在匈牙利问阿尔本，他2026年至今的表现有多少在自己掌控范围内时，他这样回答。
“正在发生的事情太多了。我认为有很多因素。就拿乔治和基米[安东内利]遇到的情况来说，那不是某一辆车、某一支车队的问题。
“你可以想象，如果厂商车队都在为此挣扎，那客户车队肯定也会遇到同样的问题。
“我在排位赛中的表现相当稳定，即使是在斯帕，那里你本应排在前面却没能做到。这背后有一些原因。”
“这些原因也和我们自身有关。我认为威廉姆斯车队目前正在逐步弄明白，但塞恩斯也遇到过同样的问题，这让我们很难理解。”
“性能方面的差异会因场次不同、周末不同而变化，我们有时能解释清楚，有时则不能。”
“对我来说，今年的开局并不算最顺利。”
阿尔本现在已与威廉姆斯续约至2027年底，他感觉自己仍在摸索在这些赛车中要跑得快需要什么。而且他担心新规则可能削弱了他的关键优势。
“在某些方面，我确实认为这些规则偏离了我的优势，”阿尔本说。
“比如说，现在已经没有真正的高速弯了。我一直把高速弯视为我的强项之一，但每当遇到高速弯时，它现在要么本身就全油门通过，就像在斯帕的普松弯那样，要么我们现在进弯的速度太慢，以至于根本算不上高速弯。
“另外，还需要时间去理解这些规则。这些赛车和轮胎都非常敏感。
“目前，我还没有真正找到它们的最佳状态。有时候我可以表现还行，但总体来说很棘手。这肯定是一种不同的驾驶风格。”
确实如此，2026年的赛车已经改变了车手在常规参数之外发挥作用的领域，比如晚刹车、对高速弯的投入和接近方式。
你只需看看遥测数据曲线就能发现，队友之间在银石和斯帕等赛道上赢得和损失的时间，主要来自直道末端和出弯时的能量部署差异，而不是入弯表现。
而对于阿尔本、拉塞尔和勒克莱尔这样的车手来说，厘清哪些可以归因于动力单元的怪癖、哪些可以归因于驾驶操作，一直是让许多人头疼不已的大难题。
阿尔本说：“从某种意义上说，今年非常考验心理，因为没有任何事情是轻松的。”
“作为一支车队，我们还在和灭火器搏斗。我们有许多小火苗要扑灭，所以很难分清哪些是你自己的问题，哪些是赛车的问题，以及到底是什么问题。”
“所以，你能做的——这也是我过去三四场比赛的做法——就是纯粹专注于驾驶，把工程的事情交给工程团队。如果你觉得自己干得不错，那就是干得不错，就这样放下。”
“这是一种非常简单的备战比赛周末的方式，但实际上，我觉得在过去几个周末，正是因为这样做，我的表现变得强了很多。我认为随着赛季推进，这就像一张待办清单。我们只是逐项划掉，解决问题，然后进入下一个问题。”
这种“专注于驾驶本身”的说法也让人想起拉塞尔本赛季早些时候的言论，当时他感到沮丧，因为自己整个F1生涯一直使用的驾驶风格在2026年的赛车上并不奏效。
“每一位车手都非常愿意配合，如果有什么原因，比如你为什么在直道上慢，或者别的什么，告诉我，我就会去适应，我会想办法绕过它来驾驶，”阿尔本解释道。
“但有时候，这非常复杂。我甚至还记得银石赛道。你在两轮排位赛飞行圈之间，尝试各种不同的东西、不同的驾驶风格。我觉得这会让你的注意力从纯粹的驾驶上分散开。
“我以前说过，你这一生学到的只有如何把车开快。你知道什么是快的。突然之间，多出了一层东西，就像你脑海深处的一个灰盒子，它会让你想：‘如果我用不同的方式做这个动作，会不会以另一种方式帮助圈速？’之类的问题。这完全不是本能或自然的。”
“再说，这又回到了之前的问题：专心开车，让工程团队去做工程工作。”
detailEn: Newly recommitted Williams Formula 1 driver Alex Albon believes the 2026 regulations have neutered his key strengths in a way that might partly explain his tricky season.
Williams’s season so far has fallen well short of lofty expectations, meaning Albon and his team-mate Carlos Sainz have rarely had a chance of fighting for points.

But Albon in particular has struggled, having been outqualified 12-1 by Sainz with an average margin of nearly three tenths of a second. Things have been closer in the races and Albon has scored five of Williams’s 11 points, but there’s little doubt Sainz has been the stronger Williams driver this season, having been closely matched with Albon in their first year together last season.
Unpicking exactly why isn’t easy though, given Williams has had myriad reliability issues and performance consistency problems as well as a slower-than-expected car.

Plus the 2026 regulations and the power unit quirks that make it difficult to confidently assess which drivers are doing the best job, especially with the emergence of deployment issues like the one Mercedes revealed after Spa last month that had been affecting George Russell.
“Honestly, it's really hard to pinpoint,” Albon replied when The Race asked him in Hungary how much of his 2026 performances so far have been within his control.
“There's so much going on. I think there's multiple factors. If you just take what's happening to George and Kimi [Antonelli], that's not a single car, single team issue.
“You can imagine if the works team was struggling with it, it definitely happens to the customer teams as well.
“I can count quite consistently on qualifying sessions, even in Spa, where you should be in front and you're not. There are elements to that.
“There's elements also to ourselves as well. I think Williams, we are in the process now of understanding, but Carlos has had this issue too, where it's hard for us to understand.
“There's differences performance-wise, session to session, weekend to weekend, which we've sometimes accounted for, sometimes not.
“It's not been the cleanest of starts of the year for me.”
Albon, now recommitted to Williams until the end of 2027, feels he’s still getting to grips with what’s needed to be quick in these cars. And he fears they may have neutered key strengths of his.
“There are elements where I do think these regs are away from my strengths,” Albon said.

“Things like, there is no high speed [corners] anymore. I always consider high speed as one of my strengths, but whenever a corner is high speed, it's now either flat itself, like it was in Pouhon [at Spa], or we're just arriving so slowly now that they're not high speed.
“Then there's also just trying to understand these regs. Cars, these tyres, they're quite sensitive.
“At the moment, I haven't really found the sweet spot with them. Sometimes I can do OK, but generally speaking, it is tricky. It's a different driving style, for sure.”
It’s true that the 2026 cars have shifted in where a driver can make a difference outside of the usual parameters, like late braking or commitment and approach to high-speed corners.

You only have to look at telemetry traces to see the time won and lost between team-mates at places such as Silverstone and Spa, is due to deployment differences at the end of straights and out of corners, rather than corner entries.

And unpicking what can be explained by the quirks of the power unit and what can be explained by the driving inputs has been a big headache for many for the likes of Albon, Russell and Charles Leclerc.
“It's very psychological this year, in that sense, because there is no easy thing,” Albon said.
“As a team, we're also fighting [with] extinguishers. We have little fires that we're trying to put out, so it's hard to differentiate what's you and what's the car and what's what.

“So, all you can do, which is my approach for the last three or four races, is just purely focus on the driving and let engineering do engineering. If you think you've done a good job, you've done a good job, and leave it like that.

“It's a very simple approach to going into a race weekend, but it's actually something which I feel like my last few weekends, my performance has got a lot stronger because of doing that. I think as the year goes on, it's almost like a cross list. We just cross out, fix problems, and get to the next one.”

The ‘focus on the driving’ also has echoes of Russell’s comments earlier this season when he was frustrated that the driving style he’d used for his entire F1 career so far didn’t work with the 2026 cars.

“Every driver is very open to, if there's a reason why, for example, why you're slow on a straight or whatever, tell me and I'll adapt to it, and I'll figure out a way to drive around it,” Albon explained.

“Sometimes, though, it's very complicated. I can even remember Silverstone. You're in between qualifying runs, trying loads of different things, different styles. I think that it takes the mind away from just driving.

“I've said this before, but you've only been taught to drive quickly your whole life. You know what is quick. Suddenly, there's a layer that's this grey box in the back of your head that's like, ‘well, if I do this differently, does this help the laptime in a different way?’ kind of thing. It's not instinctive or natural.
“Then, again, it goes back to the question before of just drive and let engineering do engineering.”

relatedItems.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒
他因驶入1号弯逃生通道导致能量输出模式混乱，15号弯后刹车失灵撞上护墙
佩雷兹在博塔斯撞车前几乎已经套圈
keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's
His car's deployment pattern got confused after he took the Turn 1 escape road, leaving his rear brakes without effect at Turn 15 where he nosed into the barriers
Perez was close to lapping Bottas before the Finn's crash on the final lap

relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.
